insights: The design system uses a stark black/white contrast palette with superellipse (squircle) border-radius on buttons, creating an Apple-inspired aesthetic that aligns with the iMessage platform focus.
Button styling consistently uses rounded-full (40px calc with corner-shape support) with inner box-shadow glow effects (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 0px 0px 5px 2px inset) for a subtle depth effect.

Motion design relies heavily on JS-driven animations (Framer) rather than CSS @keyframes, with transitions limited to simple properties like color (0.4s) and background (0.2s) using custom cubic-bezier easing.
